summary: 到期扫描/待办/通知契约冻结（docs-only）on BASE d81c11c. Freezes the read-only reminder contract consumed by PH-355 and the later notification center: source ownership and adapter boundary; SourceRef/reminder_ref and frozen pending-item shape; an issue_code registry (settlement open-item overdue/clearance, cash-plan overdue, contract change/termination, billable confirmation, invoice tax qualification, budget missing/overrun, close precheck blocker, import conflict, agent-token expiry, read-model missing, module-disabled history) with severity/source/recipient mapping; recipient matrix (owner/finance/auditor all-org, pm managed projects only, member self only, revoked/inactive deny, disabled module history-only); deterministic reminder_key excludes as_of/token/channel/display so the same source fact+issue+recipient is deduped; frozen scan envelope (core.reminders.read/v1, scan_key/scan_digest, read_only=true, notifications_sent=0, missing/issues/truncated); time semantics (Asia/Shanghai as_of, no future, due/overdue/30-day horizon, overdue never moved); null+missing discipline; idempotent repeated scan with no queue/read-state/audit/outbox/external send; permission/rejection paths; PH-301/314/PH-355 boundaries (no inbox persistence/read state/external push in this slice; no new canonical topic/command/schema; no implementation/migration/table); PH-355 acceptance and counterexamples; change control. Updates PH-355 depends_on to include PH-364 and its blocker to the remaining PH-179/PH-183/PH-151 proposed dependencies; keeps all notification-center tasks proposed. No product code, migration, contract-schema, CI-gate or canonical change. Reviewer round-1 blocker fixed: scan_digest now explicitly canonicalizes the envelope excluding both generated_at and scan_digest itself (no self-reference); the spec adds two frozen golden vectors with expected hashes (empty result 7e9894b1…, one changed settlement reminder 42d1a265…) and requires PH-355 to assert same-input/same-digest and changed-fact/changed-digest.

review.reviewer: independent PH-364 due-scan/todo/reminder contract reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER - `scan_digest` is defined circularly: §4.2 says it is sha256 of the canonical JSON of the complete envelope except `generated_at`, but that envelope contains `scan_digest` itself, so the field cannot be computed without already knowing its own value. The contract gives no exclusion/null-placeholder rule. Fix: freeze the digest input as the envelope excluding both `scan_digest` and `generated_at` (or define `scan_digest` as null during canonicalization), and add a golden test asserting identical digest on repeated scans and different digest when a source fact changes.

OTHER CONTENT CHECKED: owner boundaries keep due facts with their owners and core only as read projection; reminder_ref/reminder_key shapes, issue_code registry severity/source/recipient, recipient matrix (owner/finance/auditor full, pm managed project, member self, disabled/revoked denial, module-disabled history_read), read-only zero-write/`notifications_sent=0`, null+missing/no fabricated zero, as_of/period/window/truncation ordering, PH-355 adapter/envelope boundary and PH-301/314 persistence boundary are documented; PH-355 depends_on now includes PH-364 with its original blockers; no implementation/migration/table/product code/canonical schema change; 10 files within the PH-364 whitelist? only 6 changed; no placeholders; task_count 287; check ok=287; governance 23 OK; verify-change --base d81c11c --task PH-364 only review/acceptance gates, no path_out_of_scope.
